question_html: Mohan starts from point A and walks 1 km towards south, turns left and walks 1 km. Then he turns left again and walks 1 km. Now he is facing:
answer_html: Answer: (C) North — Mohan walks South, turns Left (facing East), turns Left again (facing North)[cite: 18]. So he is facing North[cite: 18].

question_html: Suresh starts from a point, walks 2 miles towards south, turns right and walks 1½ miles, turns left and walks 1½ miles and then he turns back. What is the direction he is facing now?
answer_html: Answer: (D) North — Suresh walks South, turns Right (West), turns Left (South), then turns back (180°)[cite: 18]. He is now facing North[cite: 18].

question_html: A man starts from a point, walks 4 miles towards north and turns left and walks 6 miles, turns right and walks for 3 miles and again turns right and walks 4 miles and takes rest for 30 minutes. He gets up and walks straight 2 miles in the same direction and turns right and walks one mile. What is the direction he is facing?
answer_html: Answer: (B) South — Walking East (4 miles + 2 miles), then turning Right faces South[cite: 18].

question_html: Arun started from point A and walked 10 kms East to point B, then turned to North and walked 3 kms to point C and then turned West and walked 12 kms to point D, then again turned South and walked 3 kms to point E. In which direction is he from his start point?
answer_html: Answer: (C) West — Net displacement: x = 10 - 12 = -2 km (West), y = 3 - 3 = 0 km[cite: 18]. Thus he is West of his starting point[cite: 18].

question_html: A starts from a point and walks 5 kms north, then turns left and walks 3 kms. Then again turns left and walks 5 km. Point out the direction in which he is going now.
answer_html: Answer: (B) South — Walking North, turns Left (West), turns Left again (South)[cite: 18]. So he is going South[cite: 18].

question_html: A rat runs 20 kms towards East and turns to right runs 10 kms and turns to right runs 9 kms and again turns to left runs 5 kms and then turns to left runs 12 kms and finally turns to left and runs 6 kms. Now what direction is the rat facing?
answer_html: Answer: (B) North — After turning left from facing East (after running 12 kms East), the rat faces North[cite: 18].

question_html: A driver left his village and drove North for 20 kms, after which he stopped for breakfast. Then he turned left and drove another 30 kms, when he stopped for lunch. After some rest, he again turned left and drove 20 kms before stopping for evening tea. Once more he turned left and drove 30 kms to reach the town where he had supper. After evening tea in which direction did he drive?
answer_html: Answer: (B) East — At evening tea he was facing South[cite: 18]. Turning left means driving East[cite: 18].

question_html: A man is facing East, then he turns left and goes 10 m, then turns right and goes 5 meters then goes 5 meters to the South and from there 5 meters to West. In which direction is he from his original place?
answer_html: Answer: (C) North — Position relative to start: x = 5 - 5 = 0, y = 10 - 5 = 5 m North[cite: 18]. So he is North of his original place[cite: 18].

question_html: From her home Prerna wishes to go to school. From home she goes towards North and then turns left and then turns right, and finally she turns left and reaches school. In which direction her school is situated with respect to her home?
answer_html: Answer: (B) North-West — North -> Left (West) -> Right (North) -> Left (West)[cite: 18]. School lies in the North-West quadrant from home[cite: 18].

question_html: A child walks 25 feet towards North, turns right and walks 40 feet, turns right again and walks 45 feet. He then turns left and walks 20 feet. He turns left again walks 20 feet. Finally, he turns to his left to walks another 20 feet. In which direction is the child from his starting point?
answer_html: Answer: (D) East — Net x = 40 + 20 - 20 = 40 feet East; Net y = 25 - 45 + 20 = 0[cite: 18]. He is East from his starting point[cite: 18].

question_html: Raju facing North and moves 20 kms, then he turned to his right and moves 20 kms and then he moves 10 kms in North-East, then he turned to his right and moves 20 kms and then he turned to his right and moves 20 kms and again he turned to his left and moves 20 kms. Now in which direction Raju is facing?
answer_html: Answer: (A) South-East — After the sequence of turns, facing direction is South-East[cite: 18].

question_html: K is a place which is located 2 kms away in the north-west direction from the capital P. R is another place that is located 2 kms away in the south-west direction from K. M is another place and that is located 2 kms away in the north-west direction from R. T is yet another place that is located 2 kms away in the south-west direction from M. In which direction is T located in relation to P?
answer_html: Answer: (C) West — P -> K (NW) -> R (SW) brings R directly West of P at distance 2√2 km[cite: 18]. M (NW) -> T (SW) shifts further West[cite: 18]. So T is West of P[cite: 18].

question_html: Babu is Rahim's neighbour and his house is 200 meters away in the north-west direction. Joseph is Rahim's neighbour and his house is located 200 meter away in the south-west direction. Gopal is Joseph's neighbour and he stays 200 meters away in the south-east direction. Roy is Gopal's neighbour and his house is located 200 meters away in the north-east direction. Then where is the position of Roy's house in relation to Babu's?
answer_html: Answer: (A) South-East — Roy's house lies to the South-East of Babu's house[cite: 18].

question_html: A tourist drives 10 km towards west and turns to left and takes a drive of another 4 km. He then drives towards east another 4 km and then turns to his right and drives 5 km. Afterwards he turns to his left and travels 6 km. In which direction is he from the starting point?
answer_html: Answer: (D) South — Net x = -10 + 4 + 6 = 0; Net y = -4 - 5 = -9 km (South)[cite: 18]. So he is South from the starting point[cite: 18].

question_html: A man started walking West. He turned right, then right again and finally turned left. Towards which direction was he walking now?
answer_html: Answer: (A) North — West -> Right (North) -> Right (East) -> Left (North)[cite: 18]. He is walking North[cite: 18].

question_html: One evening, Raja started to walk toward the Sun. After walking a while, he turned to his right and again to his right. After walking a while, he again turned right. In which direction is he facing?
answer_html: Answer: (D) North — Evening Sun is in the West[cite: 18]. Turning right three times from West results in facing North[cite: 18].

question_html: Five boys A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a park in a circle. A is facing South-West, D is facing South-East, B and E are right opposite A and D respectively and C is equidistant between D and B. Which direction is C facing?
answer_html: Answer: (A) West — B is facing NE[cite: 18]. D is facing SE[cite: 18]. C sits midway between D and B on circle, facing West[cite: 18].

question_html: If a man on a moped starts from a point and rides 4 kms South then turns left and rides 2 kms and turn again to the right to ride to go more towards which direction is he moving?
answer_html: Answer: (D) South — South -> Left (East) -> Right (South)[cite: 18]. He is moving South[cite: 18].

question_html: A man starts from a point, walk 8 kms towards North, turns right and walks 12 kms, turns left and walks 7 km turns and walks 20 kms towards South, turns right and walks 12 kms. In which direction is he from the starting point?
answer_html: Answer: (B) South — Net x = 12 - 12 = 0; Net y = 8 + 7 - 20 = -5 km (South)[cite: 18]. He is South from the starting point[cite: 18].

question_html: Daily in the morning the shadow of Gol Gumbaz falls on Bara Kaman and in the evening the shadow of Bara Kaman falls on Gol Gumbaz exactly. So in which direction is Gol Gumbaz to Bara Kaman?
answer_html: Answer: (A) Eastern side — Morning Sun is in East, shadow falls to West (on Bara Kaman)[cite: 18]. So Gol Gumbaz is to the Eastern side of Bara Kaman[cite: 18].

question_html: Ashok went 8 kms South and turned West and walked 3 kms again he turned North and walked 5 kms. He took a final turn to East and walked 3 kms. In which direction was Ashok from the starting point?
answer_html: Answer: (D) South — Net x = -3 + 3 = 0; Net y = -8 + 5 = -3 km (South)[cite: 18]. Ashok was South from starting point[cite: 18].

question_html: If X stands on his head with his face towards south, to which direction will his left hand point?
answer_html: Answer: (B) West — When standing on feet facing South, left hand points East[cite: 18]. Standing upside down facing South reverses left hand to West[cite: 18].

question_html: I drove East for 5 miles then drove North 3 miles, then turned to my left and drove for 2 miles and again turned to my left. Which direction am I going now?
answer_html: Answer: (A) South — East -> North -> Left (West) -> Left (South)[cite: 18]. Going South now[cite: 18].

question_html: If A stands on his head with his face towards north. In which direction will his left hand point?
answer_html: Answer: (C) East — When standing on feet facing North, left hand points West[cite: 18]. On head facing North, left hand points East[cite: 18].

question_html: A car travelling from south covers a distance of 8 kms, then turns right and runs another 9 kms and again turns to the right and was stopped. Which direction does it face now?
answer_html: Answer: (A) South — Travelling North (from South) -> Right (East) -> Right (South)[cite: 18]. Facing South now[cite: 18].

question_html: A taxi driver commenced his journey from a point and drove 10 kms toward north and turned to his left and drove another 5 kms. After waiting to meet a friend here, he turned to his right and continued to drive another 10 km. He has covered a distance of 25 kms so far, but in which direction would he be now?
answer_html: Answer: (B) North — After turning right while facing West, he drives North[cite: 18]. So he is heading North[cite: 18].

question_html: A walks 3 kms northward and then he turns left and goes 2 kms. He again turns left and goes 3 kms. He turns right and walks straight. In which direction is he walking now?
answer_html: Answer: (B) West — North -> Left (West) -> Left (South) -> Right (West)[cite: 18]. He is walking West[cite: 18].

question_html: A walks southwards, then turns right, then left and then right. In which direction is he from the starting point?
answer_html: Answer: (A) South-West — South -> Right (West) -> Left (South) -> Right (West)[cite: 18]. Displacement is both South and West, so South-West[cite: 18].

question_html: A man starts from a point, walks 15 metres towards East, turns left and walks 10 metres, turns right again and walks. Towards which direction is he now walking?
answer_html: Answer: (B) East — East -> Left (North) -> Right (East)[cite: 18]. He is walking East[cite: 18].

question_html: A boy starts walking towards west, after a while walking he turns right and after walking for 20 minutes. Towards which direction he is walking now?
answer_html: Answer: (B) North — West -> Right (North)[cite: 18]. Walking North now[cite: 18].

question_html: I stand with my right hand extended side-ways towards South. Towards which direction will my back be?
answer_html: Answer: (B) West — Right hand towards South means facing East[cite: 18]. Facing East means back is towards West[cite: 18].

question_html: If a person moves 4 kms towards west, then turns right and moves 3 kms and then turns right and moves 6 kms, which is the direction in which he is now moving?
answer_html: Answer: (A) East — West -> Right (North) -> Right (East)[cite: 18]. Moving East now[cite: 18].

question_html: If Mohan sees the rising sun behind the temple and the setting sun behind the railway station from his house, what is the direction of the temple from the railway station?
answer_html: Answer: (C) East — Rising sun = East (Temple is East of house)[cite: 18]. Setting sun = West (Railway station is West of house)[cite: 18]. Temple from Railway Station is East[cite: 18].

question_html: Laxman went 15 kms to North then he turned West and covered 10 kms. Then he turned south and covered 5 kms. Finally turning to East he covered 10 kms. In which direction he is from his house?
answer_html: Answer: (C) North — Net x = -10 + 10 = 0; Net y = 15 - 5 = 10 km (North)[cite: 18]. He is North from his house[cite: 18].

question_html: A man starts from a point, walks 4 miles North, turns to his right and walks 2 miles, again turns to his right and walks 2 miles, again turns to his right and walks 2 miles. In which direction would he be now from his starting point?
answer_html: Answer: (A) North — Net x = 2 - 2 = 0; Net y = 4 - 2 = 2 miles (North)[cite: 18]. He is North from starting point[cite: 18].
